title: tcqa revised-transcript front matter
description: Flat YAML only: 'key: value' lines and one-line lists. Field names are Portuguese because the method was born on a Portuguese corpus; the checker enforces them as written. Fields marked (computed) are written by 'tcqa classify --write' and verified by 'tcqa check'.

autor_principal.description: Main author of the corpus (the registry's autor_principal), the person whose participation is tracked; the speakers of this file are in falantes / entrevistados. Older files may hold the main speaker here

falantes.description: Speakers in order of appearance; one entry means a solo talk (no labels allowed). Must match the labels used in the text

entrevistador.description: Label of the person conducting the interview (host); null for a solo talk

entrevistados.description: Labels of the interviewed / main speakers

mencionados.description: People talked about but not speaking (corpus control)

autor_principal_participa.description: Corpus control: does autor_principal speak in this file (true) or is only mentioned or absent (false)?

evidencia_falantes.description: Evidence for each speaker name: header Autor, file name, quotes with their paragraph

tipo.description: Palestra | Podcast | Live | Entrevista | Curso | Outro

data.description: As precise as the source allows (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD)

audio_recuperavel.description: Is the audio still available to resolve markers later?

idioma.description: Language code of the text (pt-BR, en, ...). Detected by tcqa classify; null when unsure

falante_nativo.description: false: odd grammar belongs to the speaker and is never corrected

derivado_de.description: null for a source transcript; source file name for a translation

raw_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw file (or of the source file, for a translation)

palavras_corpo.description: (computed) body words outside front matter, labels and notes

termos_corrigidos.description: (computed) number of T1 lexicon entries in the log

classe_calculada.description: (computed) A = 0 %, B ≤ 2 %, C > 2 % of words inside [[?? ]]

classe_qualidade.description: Final class: equals classe_calculada unless override_motivo moves it by one step

override_motivo.description: One sentence; required when classe_qualidade differs from classe_calculada

apto_rag.description: (computed) false only when more than half of the words are unrecoverable

apto_finetuning.description: (computed) false for class C, for translations, and for languages outside the configured scope

segmentos_nao_conteudo.description: Non-content paragraphs (ads, jingles) kept in the text but excluded from exports by default, e.g. ["1:anuncio", "29-30:anuncio"]

pct_nao_conteudo.description: (computed) share of body words inside segmentos_nao_conteudo

contem_dados_pessoais.description: Personal contact data read on air (e-mail, phone, address) is in the text, kept as heard
